limitations: Synthetic voices do not represent the full diversity of real PT-BR speech.
Network latency and provider load vary between executions.
Cost is estimated from duration or provider-reported token usage and the versioned price catalog.
The harness does not persist audio, prompts, or returned transcripts in its result file.
trustBasis: push event, not pull_request or pull_request_target
detached checkout of the exact GITHUB_SHA
testedSha matched git rev-parse HEAD and TRANSCRIPTION_BENCHMARK_TESTED_SHA
working tree was clean before and after provider access
OPENAI_API_KEY was scoped to the benchmark step and masked in logs
GITHUB_TOKEN had contents:read only and checkout credentials were not persisted
result contained 12 sanitized observations, no transcripts, audio, prompts or credential material
artifact digest and result SHA-256 were independently revalidated after download

requiredControls: checked-out HEAD is resolved locally and matches every declared SHA
working tree is clean before execution
provider credential is scoped only to the trusted benchmark process
execution is not a pull_request workflow running mutable head code with repository secrets
result JSON is sanitized and hash-addressed

invalidatedRuns.invalidatedReason: The pull_request workflow checked out mutable PR code and exposed OPENAI_API_KEY to the benchmark step. No credential leak was observed, but the run cannot be canonical evidence.
The repository does not contain a trusted-execution attestation sufficient to promote this run as canonical evidence.

reusePolicy.note: The canonical run may be reused by a later evidence-only head only after proving that every listed runtime, harness, test and fixture path is unchanged from canonicalRun.testedSha.
